description:
Trust Receipt v1 — masking-tier-carrying frozen shape.

Fields carry forward from the shield-service v0 shape byte-verbatim.
The single addition is `masking_tier: str` (Owner P1 condition i),
validated against the positive allowlist at emission time.

audit_id.description: Foreign key into the shield audit log; ties receipt to its call.
audit_id.title: Audit Id

consumer_id.description: The consumer (application / caller) that requested the LLM invocation.
consumer_id.title: Consumer Id

de_id_summary.description: Counts per de-id class (e.g., PERSON, EMAIL, PHONE) landed by layers 1-3.
de_id_summary.title: De Id Summary

dilution_score.description: Dilution metric: how much of the original identifier-bearing surface was replaced.
dilution_score.title: Dilution Score

exposure_reduction_score.description: Exposure-reduction metric: heuristic upper-bound on residual identifier surface.
exposure_reduction_score.title: Exposure Reduction Score

llm_model.description: Provider-specific model identifier used for the call.
llm_model.title: Llm Model

masking_tier.description: Masking-tier tag (P1 condition i). Legal values are the positive allowlist at docs/mandates/masking_tier_allowlist.v0.json. `full_deid` is the standard operating mode; other tiers document degraded paths (dev echo, unsupported language, perception fallback). Emission with a non-allowlist value is refused.
masking_tier.title: Masking Tier

purpose.description: Purpose label under which the call was made (governed vocabulary).
purpose.title: Purpose

request_hash.description: SHA-256 of the request content (post-de-id, pre-LLM). Prefix `sha256:`.
request_hash.title: Request Hash

response_hash.description: SHA-256 of the LLM response (post-re-id, as returned to caller). Prefix `sha256:`.
response_hash.title: Response Hash

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 hex signature over canonical JSON of receipt minus this field.
signature.title: Signature

tenant_id.description: Tenant identity — the receipt's per-tenant HMAC key is derived from this via HKDF.
tenant_id.title: Tenant Id

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of receipt issuance.
timestamp.title: Timestamp

version.description: Schema version. v1 is the masking_tier-carrying shape.
version.title: Version

title: TrustReceiptV1
